integrity: Self-contained proof and exact coefficient identities supplied. Independent validation not performed. The reproducibility checker is finite corroboration, not a replacement for the infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted L²(0,1), fixed Schatten exponent p>1 or fixed rank k as m grows; the theorem gives no uniformity near p=1 or as k grows. The full singular spectrum at finite m is not given. The local bulk limit is connected to existing generalized locally Toeplitz theory and could admit an alternative derivation. Independently audited status is not claimed.
title: Sharp polynomial-annihilator spectra for Volterra integration
